people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Father of Baasha, king of Israel

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.
translations.bsb: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.
translations.kjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
translations.asv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, and reigned twenty and four years.
